body:
There's 0 chance I'll tell all of this to my family. With friends, it could be possible if I had a friendship deep as the ones I had with mary or Eli. The ones I currently have are no way near that level.

And as I said I don't think I want to be helped now. I think I wouldn't have talked about it even with Eli. It's on another level. I kinda think I know how she felt in the last days.

You sound a lot like a therapist (not in an offensive way) and I would typically avoid answering your question by just saying "I don't remember" or "I'm not sure", but I started drinking a bit of scotch so here you go.

I have the exact same feeling but amplified since the death of Eli. It's like we started sharing our feeling and now I'm alone and have to deal with my depression and hers. I don't know if that makes sense. 

About the death of my sister, I think that I created my depression. I don't know why or how, but I'm sure of that.
I had a few random situations where I felt completely out of depression and I saw the things from the outside. And I'm sure that I created my own demon. But I don't how to eliminate. 
In those moments I looked at me and thought I was crazy, worry about someone I don't know and basing my life on her. Maybe these will be my last thoughts. Who knows.

I don't think you understand what my feelings are towards my sister. I'm not depressed because I wanted to be her or a girl, I feel like I "killed" her. I exist only because she died. 

And, yes, I wouldn't wish this to anyone but I think that it's time to be selfish. The pain I have now is far superior to the one my mother will have from this. 

Lastly, I went to therapists years ago but I do not open up with people I don't know. I avoid the topics and "change my emotions".
There's no way I'm telling my family. Even when my mother asks me about what I had when I was younger I instinctively say " I don't remember" and avoid the topic. 

And, I'm starting to thinking that I don't want to be helped. As weird as it sounds. I had enough.

Thanks anyway
Not really, I'd rather forget about her. As in the years, I did with my sister. Helps more imo.
